title: Read a route parameter
summary: NestJS: Read a route parameter. Visit /hello/Asha.
introduction: @Param reads a named part of the route. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
learningObjectives: Read a route parameter with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Read a route parameter

blocks.text: The Param decorator takes the name segment from the URL. The handler receives Ravi.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A TypeScript type does not validate a value sent over HTTP.
